finalText:
No test suite in this repo to run. The migration is complete — only `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query`, and it's explicitly marked "do not edit" (vendored, overwritten on every upgrade), so it's correctly left alone.

**Summary:** Migrated 36 call sites across 12 files (sla, macroAdmin, returnService, couponService, variantAdmin, supplier, cohort, refund, apiKeyAdmin, shipment, teamService, session) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used in migrated files like `packages/accounts/src/repo/user.js`.
